title: Trade Phase 2 - AB5 Risk/Return Efficiency Research

magnitude_sensitivity.definition: Scale only the magnitude of already-planned AB5 buy clipping and trim shares; AB5 triggers and source risk thresholds remain unchanged. This is a sensitivity point, not a production parameter proposal.
magnitude_sensitivity.interpretation: Lower AB5 intervention magnitude materially restores return and exposure, but worsens maximum drawdown by about 0.68 percentage point. It also reduces internal fills while increasing date-symbol-side buckets and explicit fees because the changed exposure path creates different transactions. Therefore transaction count alone is not a valid objective.

book_level_super_winner.definition: existing profit-lock active + positive gain + close above short MA + short MA above long MA + close-known 60-session relative strength above fixed-universe median

lifecycle_attribution_current_ab5.interpretation: AB5 often intervenes in profitable holdings, and about 30.1% of observed trim notional is directed at book-level super-winners. Most trim actions nevertheless occur under ordinary capacity rather than an active alert or newly confirmed shock.

equal_risk_lifecycle_reallocation.candidate: Keep AB5 triggers, caps, stress math, buy scales, required relief, shock handling and alert handling unchanged; only source ordinary trims from symbols containing close-known super-winner books after other symbols, with winners still reducible when necessary.
equal_risk_lifecycle_reallocation.decision: NO_EFFECT. Do not continue with nearby winner-last score-ordering variants; the tested equal-risk ordering has no causal effect on the frozen portfolio path.

reject: Do not directly productionize a global 0.5 AB5 intensity; it weakens realized drawdown protection and would add a new production control.
Do not productionize the lifecycle-aware trim-source ordering candidate; it is economically identical to Current.
Do not search nearby AB5 intensity values or winner-order score variants merely to optimize this frozen window.
phase_decision.supported_inference: The large AB5 opportunity cost is not explained by ordinary trim-source ordering alone. The evidence points more strongly to exposure suppression / buy clipping and subsequent churn as the next research target.
phase_decision.next_phase: Phase 3 execution efficiency: attribute sell-rebuy chains, direct costs, interim downside avoided, reacquisition price effects, multi-fill buckets and low-value pure-AB5 churn without deleting effective risk actions.

evidence_identity.magnitude_sensitivity_test_result: 1 intentional receipt failure; 1278 other tests and 318 subtests passed; Python 3.11, typecheck and security succeeded
evidence_identity.equal_risk_reallocation_test_result: 1 intentional receipt failure; 1278 other tests and 318 subtests passed; Python 3.11, typecheck and security succeeded

limitations: The 0.5 sensitivity point is not an approved production threshold and is not evidence that arbitrary weakening of AB5 is safe.
Book-level and symbol-level winner attribution use different units and therefore their action-value shares must not be conflated.
Internal sleeve fill counts and date-symbol-side buckets are diagnostic execution units, not verified broker-order counts.
